name: Anangu (Pitjantjatjara/Yankunytjatjara)
notes: Western Desert cultural bloc, Central/Western Desert including Uluru-Kata Tjuta, spanning WA/SA/NT. Term coined for the bloc by Ronald M. Berndt, "The Concept of 'the Tribe' in the Western Desert of Australia," Oceania 30(2), 1959 — roughly 40 dialectal groups sharing a dialect continuum, social organization, and religious/mythological tradition. Non-state, clan/kinship-based sociopolitical organization; no Polity entity modeled.
